claims.evidence: Thesis 6.2.10.1: RPE1 NHT and USP32KO cells SILAC-labelled, lysates mixed 1:1, 50 ug of the pooled sample removed for full-proteome analysis, rest acetone-precipitated, LysC/trypsin digested and diGly-IP enriched. Two sub-experiments searched separately (txt_gg_ip.zip, txt_global_prot.zip). Source names = cell line + genotype + diGly-enriched/total (precedent PXD024103 KGG-enriched/total) so the (source, bio rep, tech rep, fraction) coordinate is unique across the two parts.

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: 36 of 72 deposited raw files annotated. The 36 "Mila" files (20180320_FB_Mila_GGIP_{1-3}_{4,5,6,7,85,12}.raw and 20180403_FB_Mila_GGIP_Prot_{1-3}_{1-6}.raw; MaxQuant experiments M1-M3 / m1-m3, searched together with the USP32 runs) are excluded: their samples are not described in PRIDE, the Cell Rep paper abstract or the Hertel thesis. "Mila" is Mila Basic (thesis acknowledgements; USP11 project, JBC 2021 PMC8546420, whose data are PXD022143 and which describes no SILAC diGly experiment). Their total-proteome USP11 H/L ratios (0.61, 0.42) hint at USP11 depletion in the heavy channel, but no source states cell line, genotype or channel map. Recorded in annotations/BLOCKED.md.

Cell Rep full text (Methods, STAR Methods, supplementary tables) not retrieved: no PMC copy, cell.com PDF 403 (not bypassed), Elsevier API metadata only. Sample-level facts come from the first author's doctoral thesis (same experiment, same MS protocol text as PRIDE) and the PRIDE protocol.

comment[precursor mass tolerance] = not available: MaxQuant parameters.txt/summary.txt do not record precursor (first/main search) tolerance and no mqpar.xml was deposited. convert-openms therefore fails (expected).
MaxQuant version: PRIDE and thesis say 1.5.1, deposited parameters.txt says 1.6.1.0 (not an SDRF column; noted only).
Heavy medium contained K8 and R10 (thesis), but MaxQuant quantified Lys8 only ("activated SILAC quantification (K8)"); the SDRF lists only the searched label.

USP32 total-protein H/L ratios in a1-a3 are ~1 (0.97, 0.83, 1.02) despite the knockout (polyclonal CRISPR pool; peptides from the residual/truncated protein still quantified). The channel orientation rests on the explicit thesis statement plus the diGly-site ratios, which match Figure 3-4C.

Technical vs biological replicates: taken from the thesis legend ("one SILAC sample set with three technical replications"); the three total-proteome replicates a1-a3 are assumed to be paired with diGly replicates A1-A3 by number.
MaxQuant summary.txt also lists 10 "GG_sens" files (20180407_*_GG_sens_1_*) that were searched but not deposited; they are not in the SDRF.
